captions.start: Hands on the wall, arms straight

steps.text: Stand an arm's length from a wall. Put your hands flat on it at shoulder height, shoulder-width apart.
Keep your body straight from head to heels, then bend your elbows.
Bring your chest towards the wall, only as far as is comfortable.
Push back until your arms are straight again.

safety: Wear shoes that grip, on a floor that does not slip.
Stop if you feel pain in your shoulders, elbows or wrists.

mistakes.label: hips_sag
mistakes.wrong: your hips dropped towards the wall, so your body was not straight
mistakes.right: Keep your body straight; do not let your hips drop towards the wall.

mistakes.label: hips_back
mistakes.wrong: your hips were pushed back, so your body bent at the hips
mistakes.right: Keep your body straight; do not push your hips back.

setup: Stand side-on to the phone, with the wall at one edge of the picture.
